kind: bounded literal effective-date span-selection measurement validation

confidence.note: JEV confidence is distribution concentration for the selected option, not a correctness or accuracy probability and not a permission to act.

interpretation.measurement_only: This measures literal date span selection, not an options edge and not a financial result.
interpretation.reference_is_model_assisted: The reference is the acting agent's own reading, not an independent human reference; agreement may reflect reference error and is not ground truth.
interpretation.no_accuracy_claim: Agreement between one model-assisted reference and one model on 30 in-sample exposed rows does not prove general accuracy and does not prove alpha.
interpretation.signed_days: A selected date yields a signed calendar-day offset from filing date; negative, zero and positive are valid and no_match is a separate category.
interpretation.confidence: JEV confidence is distribution concentration for the selected option, not correctness.
interpretation.wilson_note: Wilson intervals describe sampling noise only and do not include reference uncertainty, which is a model-assisted reading and may be wrong.
interpretation.next_step: A later financial study would need ordinary-day comparison and a predeclared economic channel; nothing here establishes one.
interpretation.next_financial_study_eligibility: Nothing here makes a financial study eligible by itself. A later financial study would require, in advance: (1) a literal, unambiguous effective-date span at coverage fixed by a predeclared rule; (2) a predeclared signed-day quantity compared with ordinary days for the same names, never fitted; (3) a predeclared economic channel from that quantity to exactly one of the five strategies before any price is opened; and (4) the out-of-sample and sealed windows untouched during design. None of these is established here, and date availability alone is not alpha.

privacy: Aggregate counts only; no accession, ticker, CIK, filing text, character offset or individual date.

post_run_repair.what: the standalone verify subcommand had a one-line indexing defect, found after the JEV run and repaired
post_run_repair.scope: verification stage only; protocol, reference, inputs, state, questions, candidate spans, results and metrics are byte-identical
post_run_repair.scope_proof: reverting the one line reproduces the pre-repair hash exactly; recorded privately in executive_date_validation/code_repair.json
